scope: Actual narrow CAD service poses; illustrations do not prove continuous clearance or physical operation

frames.title: Support and OFF
frames.caption: Support the pendant on a padded surface. Put S1 fully OFF. Disconnect all external power.

frames.title: Open captive door
frames.caption: Release the door catch and swing to its stop. The independent keeper still retains the cell.

frames.title: Release keeper
frames.caption: Hold the cell. Rotate the keeper. Pull the ribbon; do not pull any wire.

frames.title: Remove deliberately
frames.caption: Shift toward the negative contact, then withdraw through the rear opening. Inspect wrapper and end insulator.

frames.title: Insert one compatible cell
frames.caption: Use one protected XTAR21700 6000mAh button-top. Follow the permanent + and - marks. Keep the ribbon clear.

frames.title: Latch and START
frames.caption: Close the keeper and door. Check full catch engagement. Select ON and press START. Light does not prove navigation readiness.

service_clearance.basis: Conservative continuous nominal CAD bounding box: closed assembly, released door and keeper sweeps, full cell withdrawal and specified finger approaches. This is not a supplied tolerance or full human-hand bound; physical access remains unmeasured.
